purpose: Athena's adopter-local V26-1467 M1 comparison authority: one entry per manually run Athena shadow delivery, carrying the derived source/affirmative/projectionDigest/marker summary alongside intervention and blocked-share measurements compared against the frozen manual-choreography baseline. The harness repository's separate record is product self-dogfood evidence; it neither fills nor duplicates this record's three delivery slots. A measurement artifact, not a journal. After final immutable delivery evidence, the operator manually records this derived summary outside model execution grants only after separately retaining and independently verifying the complete qualified-host projection-consumption-observation/1 artifact — spec, deliveryId, fence, entry workflows/delivery-v1.json, canonicalProjectionPath, projectionDigest, hostInvocationId, and observedAt — and immutable candidate plus GitHub evidence. The gate entry itself neither preserves nor proves that full envelope; a missing retained artifact excludes the delivery. No automatic binding-side writer or registered-delivery assumption is part of this MVP. This list is empty because no qualifying Athena shadow observation is recorded. Its location is outside every execution grant's writable paths: `.agents` is additionally protected in .agents/policy/repository-policy.json. The correlation deliveryId and fence do not establish registration, takeover, trusted operator intent, or runtime authority. Nothing here claims model isolation, runtime enforcement, M1 success, or cutover readiness.

comparisonSetRequirement.note: the counted set must match the frozen baseline's mix and count; a delivery never counts without the operator separately retaining and independently verifying the complete qualified-host projection-consumption-observation/1 artifact — including entry workflows/delivery-v1.json — from a completed exact Read of the direct canonical workflow path, plus immutable candidate and GitHub evidence, then manually recording only its derived summary outside model execution grants. The gate entry does not preserve or prove the full envelope; a missing retained artifact excludes the delivery whatever its measurements say

gateMetrics.medianOperatorInterventionsAfterAcceptan: reported in full and gates nothing. The baseline's own intervention counts are [2, 0, 0] — a median of 0, which is the floor of the metric. No non-negative count can be strictly lower, so a baseline sitting at the floor cannot demonstrate improvement in either direction. The baseline's limitations block concedes the counts are lower bounds: transcripts do not record silently granted host permission prompts, so the figure it reports is admittedly incomplete. Ceasing to gate on the figure is not licence to stop measuring it; it becomes gating again only once the baseline is re-recorded under a rubric wide enough to have headroom.
gateMetrics.blockedVersusProgressingShare: must not regress against the baseline's over the same acceptance-through-first-merge-ready-report endpoint; eventual merge and post-report wait are excluded, and the baseline must be re-recorded if its transcripts cannot derive that endpoint; the sole gating criterion
gateMetrics.policyRequiredInterruptions: recorded and reported alongside interventions, never counted as interventions

consumptionRecordContract.requiredSource: binding identifies the qualified host adapter as the source of the host-neutral projection-consumption observation; after separately retaining and independently verifying that complete artifact (including entry workflows/delivery-v1.json) and immutable candidate plus GitHub evidence, the operator manually records only this derived summary. The gate entry does not preserve or prove the full envelope, asserts no delivery registration authority, and has no automatic binding-side writer

shape.projectionDigest: the digest derived from the separately retained and independently verified full artifact

marker.deliveryId: the delivery identity from the separately retained full artifact
marker.fence: the invocation fence from that artifact
marker.consumed: the pinned generation archive proved loaded or read as the run's workflow source by the separately retained model-external event; a path name or echoed marker alone cannot satisfy this field

consumptionRecordContract.rejected: any record whose source is not the binding, whose full artifact was not separately retained and independently verified, whose only evidence is a path name or echoed marker, whose host is unsupported, or whose delivery identity or literal protected target does not match — a session-authored, otherwise agent-supplied, non-consuming, cross-repository, symlinked, or hardlinked claim is excluded and must leave the record unchanged
